_comment: Kara reads the entry under platforms for the machine it is running on.
Keys are 'windows' and 'mac' -- the shape the Mac build has always read.
DO NOT add a top-level url alongside this block: clients that check the
top level first would take it, whichever platform's zip it named.
The urls point at release assets, so the zips are not in the repo tree and
do not accumulate in its history. Keep 'windows'/'macos' in the FILENAMES:
a releases feed is matched on the asset name.
The Mac zip is built on Windows: its Kara.app is carried byte-for-byte from
the last Mac-built release so its signature, and the permissions macOS files
under it, survive. Only bump 'mac' to a version whose macos asset exists.
notes: Kara now asks "Did you mean...?" when it hears a word slightly wrong while editing - press Space to accept. The space bar works again, arrow keys switch modes, and quiet speech is no longer dropped without a word. Macs are back in step with Windows.
